title: Counting Travellers off the Base-Fare Lines on a Discounted Air Ticket Fare Brands Booking
content:
Where a fare brand carries a child discount, the travellers a no-show penalty is taken for on an Air Ticket Fare Brands booking are counted off the base-fare lines rather than off the head-count on the booking, so that a lap infant or a discounted child counts only for the share of the adult fare actually paid. A brand carries a child discount when the discount scheduled for it stands above 0 percent.

## The count, condition by condition

| Where | The travellers counted are |
| --- | --- |
| the fare brand carries a child discount and the booking's base-fare lines stand for as many travellers as are ticketed | the booking's base-fare total divided by its largest single base-fare line |
| the fare brand carries a child discount and the booking carries fewer base-fare lines than travellers ticketed | the base-fare lines standing on the booking |
| in every other case | no such weighting is taken |

The base-fare total is the sum of every base-fare line standing on the booking; the largest single base-fare line is the greatest one of them, and stands for a traveller paying the adult fare in full.

## Reading the two conditions apart

The two conditions differ only in how the base-fare lines standing on the booking compare with the travellers ticketed. Where the lines are as many as the travellers, or more, the first applies and the count is a division. Where the lines are fewer than the travellers, the second applies and the count is simply how many such lines there are.

## Worked figures, on hypothetical inputs

**Lines as many as travellers.** A booking in a brand whose scheduled child discount is 20 percent carries 3 travellers and 3 base-fare lines of 900.00, 900.00 and 720.00 USD. The base-fare total is 2520.00 USD and the largest single line is 900.00 USD, so the travellers counted are 2.8 — two adults and a child standing for four fifths of an adult.

**Fewer lines than travellers.** A booking in the same brand carries 3 travellers but only 2 base-fare lines, of 900.00 and 900.00 USD, the third traveller being an infant on the lap with no base-fare line of their own. The travellers counted are the 2 lines standing on the booking.

**Neither condition met.** A booking in a brand whose scheduled child discount is 0 percent carries 4 travellers and 4 base-fare lines. The brand carries no child discount, so no such weighting is taken.
